title: Illustration Library
slide_intent: Make the approved repertoire visible because choosing an existing asset can preserve a shared drawing language across many messages.
strategic_value: The ingredient and Whopper variations can help Burger King express different food stories without inventing a new visual style each time.
demonstration: A yellow catalog groups lettuce, tomatoes, hands, onions, pickles, bun and patty above multiple Whopper arrangements and a progressive burger sequence.
practical_value: Select the existing ingredient or product variant that fits the message while retaining its supplied colors.

content_islands.name: Library introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the Cachetejack credit and no-color-amendment statement at upper left.

content_islands.name: Ingredients catalog
content_islands.spec: Arrange labeled ingredient groups across the upper-right area, including whole and sliced forms.

content_islands.name: Products catalog
content_islands.spec: Arrange Whopper variants, hands, sequence and deconstructed stack across the lower-right area.

ingredient.name: Approved illustration variants
ingredient.role: Provide consistent ready-made subjects for varied food messages.
ingredient.application: Select from the labeled ingredient and product library without changing colors.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Page 96 also prohibits cropping and directs library expansion to the Global Design Team.

reference_purposes.Expression: The catalog reveals consistent contours, textures and palette across many food subjects.
reference_purposes.Application: Labels distinguish approved ingredient and product options for selection.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page explicitly says no colors should be amended.
